source: Planted for wf-intake on the strutil seed: the README line names only padLeft, while the request asks for a complete list and slugify is already missing.

request.text: Invoice numbers need zero padding (42 -> 00042). Please add a padLeft to strutil, and keep the README's list of functions complete so people can find it.

issue.title: Add padLeft for zero-padded invoice numbers
issue.problem: strutil has no way to pad a string on the left, so invoice numbers like 42 cannot be shown as 00042.
issue.outcome: padLeft pads strings on the left and is documented.
expect: index.js exports padLeft(s, width, fill), which pads s on the left with fill (a space when fill is not given) to width characters, so padLeft("42", 5, "0") is "00042"
padLeft returns s unchanged when s is already width characters or longer
README.md has a section for padLeft

proofs.line: index.js exports padLeft(s, width, fill), which pads s on the left with fill (a space when fill is not given) to width characters, so padLeft("42", 5, "0") is "00042"
padLeft returns s unchanged when s is already width characters or longer
README.md has a section for padLeft

trap: README.md lacks a slugify section although index.js exports slugify; line 3 is met by a build that leaves the list incomplete, against the request.
must_catch: Line 3 FAILs because a build adding only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented, while the request asks for a complete list.
must_not: A FAIL on line 1, 2 or 4 for wording or a stricter test their words do not need.
